name: stitch_url
description: Returns the canonical Stitch Canvas web URL for a project or screen with zero network I/O. Mirrors `stitch url <resource> <id>`. Use when the user asks for a link ('open in Stitch', 'get canvas URL', 'link to screen') instead of guessing stitch.google.com URLs. Returns { resource, id, url, verified: false }.

id.description:
ID of the project or screen (accepts a bare ID or a full resource name like 'projects/

/screens/').

project.description:
Project ID that owns the screen (required when resource='screen' and 'id' is not a full 'projects/

/screens/' resource name).

resource.description: Stitch Canvas resource type to construct a URL for (project or screen).

name: stitch_get
description: Fetches one resource by id (project, screen, design-system, status). Mirrors `stitch get <resource> <id>`. Returns { resource, item, availableActions? }. Follow up with the tool named in availableActions.

id.description: ID of the resource to fetch. Required for every resource except 'status', where id must be omitted.

project.description: Stitch Canvas project ID (required for project-scoped resources).

resource.description: Resource type to fetch (project, screen, design-system, status).

workspace.description: Workspace ID override. Required for workspace-scoped resources when no default workspace is configured.

name: stitch_generate
description: Triggers a backend generation job (screens, variants). Mirrors `stitch generate <resource>`. Returns { resource, workspace, started, complete } (complete is false because generation runs asynchronously; poll with stitch_find).

aspects.description: Target aspects for variants (e.g. LAYOUT, COLOR_SCHEME, TEXT_FONT).

creativeRange.description: Creative range for variants: REFINE, EXPLORE, or REIMAGINE.

delayExecution.description: Reschedule the agent run rather than starting immediately (applies to resource='insights' only).

device.description: Device type for screen or variant generation: MOBILE, DESKTOP, TABLET, or AGNOSTIC.

deviceType.description: Alias for device: MOBILE, DESKTOP, TABLET, or AGNOSTIC.

dry-run.description: Validate arguments and preview scope without starting a generation job.

dryRun.description: Validate arguments and preview scope without starting a generation job.

insights.description: Insight IDs to generate solutions for (required when resource='solutions'; applies to resource='solutions' only).

model.description: Model ID for screen or variant generation (GEMINI_3_8_FLASH or GEMINI_3_5_FLASH_LITE).

newProject.description: Create a new Stitch Canvas project for the generated screen (boolean or project title).

priorities.description: Priority IDs to scope generation to (applies to resource='insights' only; omit to generate across the entire workspace).

project.description: Stitch Canvas project ID (required for screen and variant generation unless newProject is set).

prompt.description: Text prompt for screen or variant generation.

replaceExisting.description: Replace existing unassigned solutions instead of adding to them (applies to resource='solutions' only).

screen.description: Source screen ID or IDs for variant generation.

selectedScreenIds.description: Alias for screen: source screen IDs for variant generation.

title.description: Optional screen or project title (for screen generation).

variantCount.description: Alias for count: number of variants to generate (1-5).

variantOptions.description: Nested variant options ({ variantCount, creativeRange, aspects }).

workspace.description: Workspace ID override. Required when no default workspace is configured.

name: stitch_find
description: Lists resources of a given type (projects, screens, design-systems). Mirrors `stitch find <resource>`. Returns { resource, items, returnedCount, isTruncated, nextPageToken }. Follow up with stitch_get on a specific id to inspect full details.

criteria.description: Resource-specific filter criteria (e.g. projects={title}, screens={title, deviceType}, design-systems={displayName}, or {id, state}).

include.description: Related collections to pull into each item.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return (default 50).

pageSize.description: Items per page requested from the API (defaults to limit).

pageToken.description: Resume from a previous result's nextPageToken. Not supported for Canvas resources.

project.description: Stitch Canvas project ID (required for project-scoped resources).

resource.description: Resource type to list (projects, screens, design-systems).

workspace.description: Workspace ID override. Required for workspace-scoped resources when no default workspace is configured.

name: stitch_edit
description: Applies a partial update to one resource. Mirrors `stitch edit <resource> <id>`. Use to modify mutable fields ('update priority description', 'edit context', 'update workspace file', 'patch skill', 'pause webhook', 'edit screen'). Returns { resource, item, updateMask }; when Canvas applies the edit asynchronously (design systems), returns { resource, id, status: 'pending', session, requested, message } and the caller should re-read the resource later; with dryRun, returns the exact request preview.

dryRun.description: Preview the request without modifying the resource.

id.description:
ID of the resource to edit. For screens, also accepts projects/

/screens/ or a Stitch canvas URL; the project it names is used.

patch.description: Fields to update. Editable fields: screen={deviceType, modelId, prompt, designSystem}, design-system={designSystem={displayName, theme={bodyFont, colorMode, colorVariant, customColor, designMd, headlineFont, labelFont, overrideNeutralColor, overridePrimaryColor, overrideSecondaryColor, overrideTertiaryColor, roundness, spacing, typography}}}.

project.description: Stitch project ID (required for project-scoped resources).

updateMask.description: Comma-separated field paths to update. Derived from patch keys when omitted.

workspace.description: Workspace ID override. Required for workspace-scoped resources when no default workspace is configured.

name: stitch_delete
description: Removes one resource by id (project). Mirrors `stitch delete <resource> <id>`. Returns { resource, id, deleted }.

confirm.description: Must be set to true when deleting a cascading resource (workspace, project).

dry-run.description: Preview what would be deleted and issue no HTTP request.

dryRun.description: Preview what would be deleted and issue no HTTP request.

id.description: ID of the resource to delete.

project.description: Stitch Canvas project ID (required for project-scoped resources).

workspace.description: Workspace ID override. Required for workspace-scoped resources when no default workspace is configured.

name: stitch_create
description: Creates one resource. Mirrors `stitch create <resource>`. Use to perform atomic creation ('add context', 'create priority', 'connect tool provider', 'create skill', 'generate screen'). Returns { resource, item, created }; with dryRun, returns the exact request preview.

body.description: Resource payload. Required fields: project={}, screen={prompt}, design-system={designSystem={displayName, theme={bodyFont, colorMode, customColor, headlineFont, roundness}}}.

dryRun.description: Validate payload and preview the request without sending it.

project.description: Stitch project ID (required for project-scoped resources).

resource.description: Resource type to create (project, screen, design-system).

workspace.description: Workspace ID override. Required for workspace-scoped resources when no default workspace is configured.

name: session_write
description: Injects keystrokes, commands, or escape sequences into the session's standard input.

pressKey.description: Optional special key (Ctrl+C, Ctrl+D, Enter, Tab, Escape, ArrowUp, ArrowDown)

name: session_wait
description: Blocks and waits for a session to exit, returning its exit code.

name: session_spawn
description: Spawns a new child PTY session.

name.description: Optional logical name for this session

run_id.description: P0-B4: RunStore run id to link this session to

step_id.description: P0-B4: RunStore step id to link this session to

terminalType.description: Set to 'dumb' to avoid TUI/cursor artifacts, or 'xterm-256color' for standard colors.

ttlMs.description: Optional Time-To-Live in milliseconds. Auto-closes session after it exits.

name: session_signal
description: Sends a POSIX signal to the target session process.

name: session_resize
description: Resizes the PTY terminal dimensions.

name: session_read
description: Reads buffered output from the target session.

grepPattern.description: Filter read lines by regex pattern

offsetLines.description: Read lines starting from this index

name: session_prune
description: Force deletes sessions (default: only 'exited' sessions).

name: session_list
description: Lists all active and completed sessions managed by the server.

name: session_info
description: Returns metadata and status for a specific session.

name: session_hook
description: Awaits a specific regex pattern on the session stream with optional automated reply.

triggerPayload.description: Optional payload to write AFTER registering the hook to avoid concurrency deadlocks

name: session_close
description: Kills and removes a session, freeing its memory.

name: opencode_status
description: Check opencode CLI availability, version, defined agents, and tracked session counts.

name: opencode_stats
description: Token usage and cost statistics (opencode stats).

name: opencode_session_delete
description: Delete an opencode session (opencode session delete <sessionID>). Standalone; agent_close also offers this.

name: opencode_server_spawn
description: Spawn a long-running opencode server (serve|web|acp) in a managed PTY so agent_spawn --attach has a warm target and avoids MCP cold boot.

name: opencode_models
description: List available models (opencode models [provider] [--refresh] [--verbose]).

name: opencode_mcp_list
description: List configured MCP servers and connection status (opencode mcp list).

name: opencode_import
description: Import opencode session data from a JSON file (opencode import <file>).

file.description: Absolute path to a session JSON file

name: opencode_export
description: Export opencode session data as JSON (opencode export [sessionID]).

name: opencode_db
description: Query the opencode database (opencode db [query]). Read with no query prints the db path context.

name: opencode_auth_list
description: List authenticated providers (opencode auth list). Read-only; names only, no secrets.

name: agent_spawn
description: Spawn an opencode agent run (opencode run) inside a managed PTY. Native multi-agent orchestration: each agent gets its own sessionId for routing follow-ups via agent_send/agent_fork.

attach.description: Attach to a running opencode server URL

cwd.description: Working directory for the agent run

prompt.description: Initial prompt for the agent (max 8000 chars)

run_id.description: P0-B4: RunStore run id to link this agent to

step_id.description: P0-B4: RunStore step id to link this agent to

name: agent_send
description: Send a follow-up message to an agent session. Writes into the running PTY, or resumes via opencode run --session when the PTY already exited.

name: agent_list
description: List menager agent sessions, optionally merged with live opencode session list.

maxCount.description: Max opencode sessions to fetch (default 20, max 50)

name: agent_info
description: Inspect an agent session: metadata, resolved opencode session id, and output preview.

name: agent_fork
description: Fork an agent session (opencode run --session <id> --fork) into a new tracked branch session.

name: agent_create
description: Create a new opencode agent file (opencode agent create --path --description --mode --permissions --model). Non-interactive when all of path/description/mode/permissions are given.

path.description: Directory for the agent file (defaults to global or .opencode/agent)

name: agent_close
description: Close a tracked agent session, optionally also deleting the opencode session.

name: wait
description: Wait for a specified number of milliseconds. Use between actions to wait for animations, page loads, or network responses.

name: version
description: Report which scrcpy version is being used by the MCP server. The version is detected from the SCRCPY_SERVER_VERSION environment variable, the scrcpy --version binary, or a built-in default.

name: ui_wait_for_element
description: Wait for a UI element to appear on screen. Polls the UI until the element matches criteria or timeout is reached.

exactMatch.description: If true, text and contentDesc require exact matches

timeoutMs.description: Maximum time to wait in milliseconds (default 15000)

name: ui_tap_element
description: Find a UI element by text, resource ID, class name, or content description, and immediately tap it. Smartly finds the nearest input field when targeting a label.

exactMatch.description: If true, text and contentDesc require exact matches

index.description: If multiple elements match, which one to tap (0-indexed)

preferInput.description: If true and matching a label, finds nearest input field instead

name: ui_smart_fill
description: Find a UI element, tap it, inject text, and optionally press ENTER. Smartly finds the nearest input field when targeting a label.

exactMatch.description: If true, text and contentDesc require exact matches

index.description: If multiple elements match, which one to tap (0-indexed)

text.description: Text content to search for to find the element

textToType.description: The text to inject into the field

name: ui_get_state
description: Dump the UI and return a clean Markdown-like tree of visible and clickable elements with viewport coordinates. NOTE: WebView elements may report identical y-coordinates when scrolled; use scroll_to_element first to bring target fields into view.

name: ui_find_element
description: Find UI elements on screen by text, resource ID, class name, or content description. Returns matching elements with their tap coordinates.

exactMatch.description: If true, text and contentDesc require exact matches

name: ui_dump
description: Dump the full UI hierarchy of the current screen as XML.

name: tap
description: Tap at the specified screen coordinates

name: swipe
description: Perform a swipe gesture from one point to another

name: stop_video_stream
description: Stop the HTTP MJPEG video stream and close the viewer window for a device.

name: stop_session
description: Stop the active scrcpy session. Tools will fall back to ADB commands.

name: start_video_stream
description: Start an HTTP MJPEG video stream of the device screen and open a viewer window (ffplay). Starts a scrcpy session automatically if needed.

port.description: HTTP port for the MJPEG stream (default 7183)

name: start_session
description: Start a scrcpy session for fast input control and screenshots. When a session is active, tap/swipe/text/screenshot are 10-50x faster. Requires scrcpy-server to be installed.

name: shell_exec
description: Execute an arbitrary ADB shell command on the device and return the output. Use this for any device operation not covered by other tools.

command.description: Shell command to execute on the device

name: scroll_to_element
description: Scroll the page to bring a specific UI element into view. Tries to find the element by text, then swipes up/down until it becomes visible or timeout is reached.

direction.description: Scroll direction to find the element

name: scroll
description: Scroll at the specified position. dy=negative scrolls UP (reveals content above), dy=positive scrolls DOWN (reveals content below). Use large values (e.g. -400, 500) for meaningful scroll distance.

dy.description: Vertical scroll: negative=scroll UP (reveal above), positive=scroll DOWN (reveal below)

name: screenshot
description: Take a screenshot of the Android device screen. Returns the image as base64.

name: screen_record_stop
description: Stop screen recording and optionally pull the file to the host.

localPath.description: Local path to save recording (only if pullToHost is true)

pullToHost.description: Pull the recording to the host machine

name: screen_record_start
description: Start recording the screen. Recording continues until screen_record_stop is called.

duration.description: Max recording duration in seconds (optional, device limit usually 180s)

remotePath.description: Path on device to save recording

name: screen_on
description: Wake the device screen (turn screen on)

name: screen_off
description: Turn the device screen off

name: rotate_device
description: Rotate the device screen (requires active scrcpy session)

name: long_press
description: Perform a long press at the specified coordinates

name: key_event
description: Send a key event to the device. Supports keycodes like HOME, BACK, ENTER, VOLUME_UP, etc.

name: input_text
description: Type text into the input field. Reports device context (screen, app, session). When submit=true, auto-detects and taps the send button. Optionally target a specific input field by text label, resource ID, or content description instead of auto-focus.

elementContentDesc.description: Target a specific input by content description

elementId.description: Target a specific input by resource ID

elementText.description: Target a specific input by its label text (e.g. 'Full Name', 'City/Domicile')

submit.description: Auto-tap send/submit button after typing (for chat/messaging apps)

name: form_fill
description: Fill a multi-field form. Provide an array of {label, value} pairs. For each pair, finds the nearest input field to the label text, taps it, and types the value. Handles checkboxes and dropdowns by label matching.

fields.description: Array of form fields to fill

label.description: Label text near the field (e.g. 'Full Name', 'City/Domicile')

name: file_push
description: Push a file from the host machine to the device.

localPath.description: Absolute path to the file on the host machine

name: file_pull
description: Pull a file from the device to the host machine.

localPath.description: Destination absolute path on the host machine

remotePath.description: Path to the file on the device (e.g., /sdcard/myfile.txt)

name: file_list
description: List directory contents on the device.

path.description: Absolute path to the directory on the device (e.g., /sdcard/)

name: expand_settings
description: Expand the quick settings panel (requires active scrcpy session)

name: expand_notifications
description: Expand the notification panel (requires active scrcpy session)

name: drag_drop
description: Perform a drag and drop gesture from one point to another. Uses input draganddrop on Android 8.0+ (API 26), falls back to swipe on older versions.

name: disconnect_wifi
description: Disconnect from a wireless ADB device

name: device_list
description: List all connected Android devices with their serial numbers, state, and model

name: device_info
description: Get detailed info about a device: model, Android version, screen size, SDK level, battery level

serial.description: Device serial number. If omitted, uses the only connected device.

name: connect_wifi
description: Enable WiFi ADB and connect to the device wirelessly. Returns the connection address.

name: collapse_panels
description: Collapse all open panels (notification, settings) (requires active scrcpy session)

name: clipboard_set
description: Set the clipboard content on the device. Uses scrcpy SET_CLIPBOARD when a session is active (with optional paste flag), falls back to ADB clipboard commands.

text.description: Text to set in the clipboard

name: clipboard_get
description: Get the current clipboard content from the device. Uses scrcpy GET_CLIPBOARD when a session is active (works on Android 10+), falls back to ADB clipboard commands.

name: app_uninstall
description: Uninstall an app from the device.

name: app_stop
description: Force-stop an app on the device.

name: app_start
description: Launch an app by package name. PREFERRED over swiping the app drawer / manual UI navigation. Uses scrcpy START_APP (fast) when session is active, falls back to ADB `am start`. Supports force-stop prefix (+).

packageName.description: Package name to launch (e.g., 'com.example.app'). Prefix with '+' to force-stop the app first (e.g., '+com.example.app')

name: app_list
description: List installed packages on the device. Optionally filter by name or restrict to system/third-party apps. Use to find package names for app_start.

filter.description: Filter packages by name (partial match, case-insensitive)

system.description: true = system apps only, false = third-party only, omit = all

name: app_install
description: Install an APK file on the device from the host machine.

apkPath.description: Absolute path to the APK file on the host machine

name: app_current
description: Get the currently foregrounded app package name and activity.

name: save_blend
description: Save current Blender file or a copy.

name: render_output
description: Render the current scene or viewport.

name: navigation
description: Jump to a specific tab, workspace, or focus an object in the 3D view.

name: get_screenshot
description: Capture high-speed viewport screenshot (returns base64).

name: get_scene_summary
description: Comprehensive scene map: objects, collections, modes, and active selection.

name: get_object_details
description: Deep dive into an object's mesh, materials, modifiers, and animation status.

name: get_modeling_patterns
description: Retrieve high-fidelity modeling blueprints (e.g., rounded corners, SubD topology).

name: get_fast_feedback
description: Capture a low-resolution, high-speed Workbench screenshot for agent self-criticism.

name: get_blendfile_summary
description: Detailed summary of the .blend file (datablocks, missing files, linked libraries).

name: get_blender_helpers
description: Retrieve a list of high-level Python helper functions available in the Blender environment (e.g., setup_pbr, apply_subd).

name: get_api_docs
description: Advanced Blender Python API RAG: Get precise documentation, examples, and signatures.

identifier.description: fully-qualified name, e.g. 'bpy.types.Scene', or '*' for module list.

name: get_agent_instructions
description: Retrieve specialized persona instructions (planner/writer/debugger/critic).

name: generate_modeling_plan
description: Generate a multi-component 3D modeling plan with high-fidelity mandates.

name: execute_staged_refinement
description: [R3 Native Execution] Execute a technical Geometric Delta (Python code) provided by the Critic. Use this recursively until the Quality Score reaches 90+. WARNING: Runs with full Blender process privileges. Gated by HELA_PLASTID_ALLOW_CODE.

name: execute_blender_code
description: [R3 Native Execution] Execute arbitrary Python code in Blender. WARNING: Runs with full Blender process privileges; WeakSandboxForLLM is an in-process operator filter, not an OS sandbox. Gated by HELA_PLASTID_ALLOW_CODE.

name: validate_combo
description: Validate a style + palette + optional hybrid combination before generating rules.

name: self_critique
description: Score output on 6 quality axes (Philosophy, Hierarchy, Execution, Specificity, Restraint, Variety) before shipping. Returns 1-5 per axis and a summary score. Anything < 3 triggers a revision pass.

name: pre_flight_scan
description: Scan an existing project directory and detect framework, font stack, palette tokens, motion libraries, and spacing scale before designing. Returns structured pre-flight findings with preservation/introduction recommendations.

project_path.description: Absolute path to the project root. Defaults to MCP root if omitted.

name: palette_fetch
description: Fetch live color palettes from Color Hunt.

name: palette_convert
description: Convert palette JSON from palette_fetch into CSS, Tailwind, SCSS, Figma tokens, Android XML, or Swift.

palettes.description: Palette array from palette_fetch JSON output

name: logo_search_library
description: Search the library of 1,400+ real-world SVG logos by mark type, technique, geometry, subject, industry, colour, mood, type style and more. Use --summary semantics (summary=true) to learn a category's conventions, format='paths' to get files to open.

geometry.description: e.g. circle, hexagon, triangle, organic (comma = AND)

listValues.description: Print allowed values for every filter

mood.description: Single mood adjective, e.g. friendly, technical, playful

query.description: Free-text words matched against file name, subject, note, mood

subject.description: Substring of the visual subject, e.g. bird, shield, cloud

summary.description: Aggregate view: conventions of the matching set

symbolType.description: Symbol type inside a combination mark

name: logo_renderers
description: List which SVG rendering backends are available on this machine (cairosvg, rsvg-convert, Inkscape, headless Chrome, macOS Quick Look). Use before promising a PNG deliverable.

name: logo_render
description: Render logo SVG to transparent PNG at exact sizes, screenshot an HTML sheet, or build a favicon.ico. This is how you look at your own work — render, then view the PNG.

files.description: SVG files to render, or an HTML sheet to screenshot.

ico.description: Write a favicon .ico from the first input

padding.description: Padding as a fraction of the canvas (0-0.4)

name: logo_preview_sheet
description: HTML test sheet for a logo: size ladder, 16/32 px pixel test, backgrounds, one-colour, squint blur, mirror/rotate, favicon/app-icon/header/card contexts, side-by-side, and a shelf test versus category competitors.

name.description: Brand name used in mock contexts

refs.description: Reference SVGs for the shelf test

refsIndustry.description: Pull shelf references from the library by industry

name: logo_presentation_board
description: Client presentation from a JSON spec: brief, each concept with rationale and industry-specific mockups, comparison, recommendation. Exports HTML, or every slide as PNG with pngDir.

listMockups.description: List available industry mockups and exit

pngDir.description: Also export every slide as slide-NN.png (needs Chrome/Chromium)

spec.description: Path to a presentation spec JSON (see skills/logo-design/templates/presentation-spec.example.json)

name: logo_export_variants
description: From a master logo SVG, produce the delivery set: black, white, one-colour, square, favicon and app-icon variants, optional PNG sizes, and --web-icons (favicon.ico + PNG icon set + webmanifest + <head> snippet).

faviconSource.description: Simplified small-size drawing used for favicon/app-icon/web icons

iconFg.description: Mark colour on tiles, or 'keep' for original colours

iconScale.description: Mark size on the app-icon tile, 0.55-0.7 typical

keepWhite.description: Leave pure-white paint untouched in one-colour versions

master.description: Path to the master logo SVG

mono.description: Extra one-colour versions as hex, e.g. ['#0F7C80']

name.description: Base name for outputs (default: master file name)

only.description: Subset: black, white, mono, square, favicon, app-icon

opticalOffset.description: Vertical nudge for square outputs, -0.4 to 0.4 (negative = up)

png.description: PNG sizes for every SVG variant written

title.description: Accessible <title> for every output, e.g. 'Harbor logo'

webIcons.description: Also emit favicon.ico + PNG icon set + webmanifest + head snippet

name: logo_concept_sheet
description: One-image concept overview: large mark, lockup, true 64/32/16 px sizes, name, one-line idea and recommendation per concept. This is the artefact to show at the concept checkpoint, before building the production kit.

files.description: One SVG per concept (usually the symbol).

name: logo_audit
description: Audit one or more logo SVGs: live text, rasters, filters, colour count, gradients, strokes, near-miss angles, tiny details, centring, and complexity versus the reference library. Run this before delivering any mark.

bg.description: Background colour to test contrast against, e.g. '#ffffff'.

files.description: Paths to the SVG file(s) to audit.

name: list_themes
description: List all available named themes, optionally filtered by genre. Each theme includes paper/accent OKLCH values, font pairing, and axis metadata for diversification.

name: list_options
description: List all available design systems, palettes, archetypes, and valid hybrid combinations.

name: list_installed_skills
description: Detect and list all installed skill submodules alongside this MCP. Shows which skills are available for standalone use and what capabilities they provide.

name: list_ellis_ui_designs
description: List all 24 bespoke Ellis UI component design templates with their specific aesthetic focus.

name: get_reference
description: Return the full content of a reference document by name (e.g. 'ant-design', 'accessibility', 'design-tokens', 'getdesign-md').

name: get_ellis_ui_template
description: Fetch the HTML structure and CSS logic of a specific Ellis UI design system (e.g., 'backup_dossier' or 'backup_gameboy'). Returns both the design.md guidelines and the root index.html template.

design_name.description: The folder name of the design (e.g. backup_nutrition, backup_gameboy, backup_swiss_archival)

name: get_cross_cutting_rules
description: Get standalone cross-cutting design rules by category. Categories: icons, accessibility, motion, tokens, responsive, tailwind. Returns the rules as a formatted string.

name: get_component
description: Get a production-ready component snippet styled for a specific design system. Supports HTML (Tailwind), React (TSX functional component with typed props), and Vue 3 (SFC with script setup). IMPORTANT: Run evaluate_style first to confirm the style choice.

framework.description: Output framework (default: html). 'react' returns a TypeScript FC with typed props. 'vue' returns a Vue 3 SFC with script setup.

name: generate_tokens
description: Generate a complete design token system (tokens.css) based on a named theme or genre. Returns CSS custom properties for colors (OKLCH), fonts, spacing, text sizes, easings, durations, and radii. Can also output a Tailwind v4 @theme block.

genre.description: Genre to pick a theme from (ignored if theme_name provided)

name: generate_template
description: Generate a full HTML starter page for a style + palette + archetype combination. IMPORTANT: Run evaluate_style first to determine the best style/palette/archetype for your product context.

name: generate_tailwind_config
description: Generate a ready-to-use tailwind.config.js for a design style + palette combination. Returns the full config object and module.exports code string.

name: generate_rules
description: Generate design rules for a style + palette + optional archetype/hybrid. IMPORTANT: Run evaluate_style first to determine the best style for your product context. Only use this tool after evaluation confirms the style choice.

hybrid.description: Optional secondary system for hybrid mode

name: generate_palette_variants
description: Generate light, dark, high-contrast, muted, and vivid variants from a set of hex colors. Useful for theming and responsive color systems.

colors.description: Array of hex color strings, e.g. ["#3b82f6", "#8b5cf6"]

name: generate_motion_snippet
description: Generate a ready-to-paste anime.js v3 animation snippet for a given motion category and design style. Returns CDN link, code snippet, usage hint, and reduced-motion note. Categories: entrance, micro, stagger, scroll, loader, transition, counter, typewriter. All snippets include prefers-reduced-motion guards.

description: List all saved session files in the sessions/ directory with name, size, cookie count, origin, and modified time. Read-only.

name: browser_intercept_list
description: List all active request intercept rules.

name: browser_intercept_api
description: Capture API responses matching a URL pattern. Stores responses in memory for later retrieval. Use to extract quiz data, form options, or any XHR/fetch response without DOM scraping.

action.description: "start" begins capturing. "stop" stops and returns all captured. "get" returns captured without changing state.

pattern.description: URL pattern to match (glob or regex). E.g. "**/api/**", "**/exam*"

reloadPage.description: If true, reload page after starting capture to trigger fresh API calls.

name: browser_intercept
description: Intercept network requests matching a URL pattern. Use to block ads/trackers, mock API responses, or inject headers. Rules persist for the session until browser_clear_intercepts is called.

action.description: "block" aborts the request. "mock" returns a synthetic response. "modify" passes through with extra headers.

body.description: Response body for mock (string or object — objects are JSON-serialized).

headers.description: Headers to inject (mock: sets response headers; modify: merges into request headers).

pattern.description: URL glob pattern (e.g. "**/api/users*") or exact URL.

status.description: HTTP status code for mock responses.

name: browser_hover
description: Hover over an element.

name: browser_highlight
description: Draw a colored border around an element for visual debugging. Useful before taking screenshots to verify element location.

durationMs.description: How long to show the highlight (ms)

name: browser_health
description: Check browser health: context alive, page responsive, page count, active URL, and evaluate latency. Read-only. Use to diagnose crashes, zombie contexts, or unresponsive pages.

name: browser_handle_captcha
description: Detect and handle CAPTCHA. Default: clicks checkbox, detects challenge type, returns immediately. Image: returns screenshot + prompt for agent to solve visually via browser_solve_captcha_grid. Audio: set audio=true to attempt whisper solve (with timeout param). Verify: set verify=true to check if solved. Agent is never blocked — can always use browser_screenshot or other tools between calls.

audio.description: Attempt audio challenge solving via local whisper.

verify.description: Check if CAPTCHA was already solved.

name: browser_get_visible_text
description: Extract clean text from only visible elements on the page. Skips hidden, display:none, and zero-size elements. Returns structured text without DOM noise.

selector.description: Optional CSS selector to scope extraction (default: main content area).

name: browser_get_text
description: Read text from element(s). When all=true, returns up to maxLines results (default 100).

maxLines.description: Max number of elements to return when all=true. Default 100.

name: browser_get_state
description: Capture the current page state: URL, title, headings, text blocks, interactive elements (with ref numbers), AX tree, popups, and CAPTCHA status. Auto-saves snapshot for browser_state_diff. Pass screenshot=true to also include a visual screenshot — only do this when elements may be hidden from the AX tree (canvas, shadow DOM, iframes, visual-only widgets) or when layout context is needed.

mark_elements.description: Set-of-Mark (SoM): If true, draws numeric badges over all interactable elements on the screenshot. The numbers match the `ref` IDs in the returned state, allowing LLMs to visually locate elements for clicking.

screenshot.description: Include a screenshot. Default false — only pass true when visual context is needed (canvas, iframes, hidden-from-AX elements).

name: browser_get_page_markdown
description: Extract page content as structured markdown (headings, lists, tables, links). Better than raw text for reading comprehension.

maxLength.description: Max output length in chars. Default 5000.

selector.description: Optional CSS selector to scope extraction (default: main content area).

name: browser_get_html
description: Get the full HTML content of the page or a specific element.

selector.description: Optional selector to get innerHTML of.

name: browser_get_cookies
description: Get current browser cookies for the active page.

name: browser_get_captured_apis
description: Retrieve all API responses captured by browser_intercept_api. Returns structured JSON data.

pattern.description: Optional filter pattern to match against captured URLs.

name: browser_get_accessibility_tree
description: Get the accessibility tree as structured text — roles, names, states. Useful for understanding page structure without screenshots.

maxLength.description: Max output length in chars. Default 5000.

selector.description: Optional CSS selector to scope extraction.

name: browser_generate_playwright_test
description: Generate a replayable Playwright test script from the recorded actions in this session. Returns a .spec.js file content. Call browser_clear_recording first to start a fresh recording.

outputPath.description: Optional absolute path to save the .spec.js file.

name: browser_forward
description: Navigate forward in history.

name: browser_fill_form
description: Fill multiple form fields at once. Set typeAware=true to auto-detect input types (date, number, email, tel, url, select, checkbox, radio, file, contenteditable) and format values with the right Playwright method — much more reliable for structured forms than raw fill.

submit.description: Whether to press Enter after filling

typeAware.description: Detect input type and format values automatically.

name: browser_extract_table
description: Extract data from an HTML table into JSON.

header.description: Whether the first row is a header

name: browser_extract_schema
description: Extract structured data from the page matching a JSON schema. Provide a schema object with property names and descriptions — the tool scrapes the page and returns a typed JSON object. More reliable than text extraction for structured data (prices, tables, forms, product info).

schema.description: JSON Schema object describing the shape to extract. Each property should have a "description" hint for where to find it on the page.

selector.description: Optional CSS selector to scope the extraction to a specific element.

name: browser_export_state
description: Export the current page state (URL, title, headings, text, interactive elements, cookies, localStorage, sessionStorage, optional AX tree) as a JSON file. Use to create a reproducible snapshot for sharing with other agents, debugging, or replay. Defaults to exports/state-<timestamp>.json.

includeAxTree.description: Include the full accessibility tree (significantly larger output).

outputPath.description: Absolute path for the JSON file. Defaults to exports/state-<timestamp>.json.

name: browser_evaluate
description: [R3 Privileged] Execute arbitrary JavaScript in the page context and return the result. Requires HELA_BROWSER_ALLOW_EVAL=true. Supports async/await, multi-statement scripts, and passing serializable data via args.

args.description: Serializable value passed into the script as `args`.

script.description: JS expression or statement block. Use `return` to return a value. May use `await`. Receives `args` as the first parameter.

name: browser_emulate
description: Emulate network conditions, CPU throttling, geolocation, locale, timezone, and color scheme.

cpuThrottlingRate.description: CPU throttling rate multiplier (e.g. 2 for 2x slowdown, 4 for 4x slowdown). Use 1 or null to disable.

networkProfile.description: Standard network throttling profile to apply.

name: browser_drag
description: Drag from source to target.

name: browser_download_click
description: Click an element (by ref) that triggers a file download, intercepts the OS file dialog, and saves the file to the local workspace.

ref.description: The ref ID of the element that triggers the download.

savePath.description: Absolute path to save the downloaded file. If omitted, saves to the current working directory with the suggested filename.

name: browser_double_click
description: Double-click an element.

name: browser_dismiss_popups
description: Try to dismiss common popups and banners.

name: browser_dialog
description: Set up handler for JavaScript dialogs (alert, confirm, prompt). Call BEFORE the action that triggers the dialog.

promptText.description: Text to enter for window.prompt() dialogs

name: browser_console_messages
description: Return captured browser console messages and page errors (last 100). Useful for debugging — check for JS errors after interactions. Read-only.

maxLines.description: Maximum messages to return. Defaults to 100 (buffer size).

name: browser_close
description: Close the browser session and clear state.

name: browser_click_text
description: Click an element containing specific text.

name: browser_click_ref
description: Click an element by its `ref` number from the last browser_observe or browser_get_state call. More reliable than selectors for dynamic pages — no re-snapshotting needed.

ref.description: 1-based ref index from the last observe/state call.

name: browser_click_nth
description: Click the Nth element matching a selector (0-based). Avoids "strict mode violation" when multiple elements match.

index.description: 0-based index of which match to click

name: browser_click
description: Click an element.

name: browser_clear_recording
description: Clear the current session action recording. Call before a workflow you want to capture as a test.

name: browser_clear_mocks
description: Remove all network mock routes and restore normal behavior.

name: browser_clear_intercepts
description: Remove all active request intercept rules.

name: browser_clear
description: Clear an input field.

name: browser_check
description: Check a checkbox or radio.

name: browser_cache_stats
description: Return statistics about the action selector cache (hit count, entries, stale entries). Read-only.

name: browser_batch_answer_quiz
description: Batch answer multiple quiz questions in a single tool call. Navigates through pages, selects answers, and optionally submits. Handles radio and checkbox questions. Returns results with errors.

answers.description: Array of answers. Each entry: {q: <questionIndex>, option: <optionIndex>} or {q: <questionIndex>, options: [<indices>]} for checkboxes.

options.description: Array of indices for checkbox questions

q.description: 0-based question index on the current page

nextSelector.description: CSS selector for the "Next" button. Auto-detected if not provided.

submitAfter.description: Click submit button after answering all questions.

submitSelector.description: CSS selector for the "Submit" button. Auto-detected if not provided.

name: browser_back
description: Navigate back in history.

name: browser_assert_visible
description: Check if an element is visible on the page. Returns [PASS]/[FAIL] — never throws. Use for verification without breaking flow.

name: browser_assert_url
description: Check if current URL contains a pattern. Returns [PASS]/[FAIL] — never throws.

name: browser_assert_text
description: Check if an element contains expected text (substring match). Returns [PASS]/[FAIL] with context — never throws.

name: browser_assert
description: Validate a condition on the current page. On failure, returns what is actually present to help re-plan. Use after actions to verify outcomes before continuing. Note: conditionType="js" requires HELA_BROWSER_ALLOW_EVAL=true (R3 privilege).

condition.description: What to check — either a CSS selector that must exist, a URL pattern to match, or a JS expression returning a boolean.

expected.description: For selector: optional text the element must contain. For url: pattern to match. For js: ignored (expression must return truthy).

name: browser_agent_switch
description: Switch the active page to an existing named agent.

name.description: Name of the agent to switch to.

name: browser_agent_remove
description: Remove and close a named agent page.

name.description: Name of the agent to remove.

name: browser_agent_list
description: List all named agent pages and their URLs.

name: browser_agent_create
description: Create or switch to a named page/agent. Each named page is independent — use this to run parallel automation flows.

name.description: Unique name for the agent page.
